lines: A man stops you. He doesn't pick a fight, but he looks so sure of himself that walking on without stopping already feels awkward.
A bandit steps in front of you. No shouting, no threat — just the smug confidence of someone used to getting his way.
A man comes up from the side. He doesn't rush you, but he stands too close and too calm for a chance meeting.
His gaze catches you. He isn't angry — he acts like the conversation already started without your say-so.
A man blocks the road. Calm, almost businesslike, but every move reeks of nerve.
You aren't stopped by force. He's confident to the point of arrogance — and that makes talking feel inevitable.
Well, well… You look fucking incredible, sweetheart. Feel like earning a few coins? I'll pay you well.
Lucky me. Hot little witch — can't take my eyes off you. Wanna make some coin? I'll pay fair.
Holy shit… You're extra tempting today. Want to get paid in gold? I know how to make it worth your while.
Oh, darling… You're making my pants tight. Want a quick handful of coins? I'll be gentle… or not.
Damn, you're hot. Don't want some coin? I'll pay you well.
Look who showed up. Juicy girl. Wanna earn? I'm generous when a girl puts in effort.
Oh boy… Especially tasty today. Coins for a good time — interested?
Hey, gorgeous. You'd get any bandit hard. Wanna make some coin?
Damn… Sweet witch. Come earn a little? I'll handle you right.
Whoa… Can't look away. Want coins? I'll pay you full, promise.
Aw, shame… I was already worked up and you shut me down.
Come on… No, wait — you're serious.
Phew. So hot — and a flat no.
Don't want to? Hurts, but I get it.
Tch… You would've liked it.
Heh-heh, blushing? Means you're not against it — just shy.
Oh, embarrassed. I like that.
Hm? Quit pretending. I can tell you're interested.
Yeah, flustered? Fine — I'll warm you up fast.
Cute when you blush. Come on, you won't regret it.
Now we're talking. You've got money on the mind — we'll sort the rest.
Smart girl. Name your terms — I'm not stingy.
Alright, I'm listening. How much you want — and what you'll do.
Wanna earn? I pay well if you don't slack.
We'll deal. You know what I want — say what you want.
I won't, I won't… well, almost. Promise I'll be almost gentle.
Fine, softer. You're a witch — you can take it.
I'll be sweeter. Though my hand keeps drifting to your hair…
Deal: not too rough — but no saint act either.
Heh, okay. I'll try. But if you moan loud I might forget the promise.
Ooh, that's what I like! Then I won't quit till you cum.
Finally a real girl! It's gonna be rough.
Damn, you're fire! Love when they ask for it hard.
Good bitch. No tenderness — straight to rough.
Now we're talking! I'll fuck you till you scream.
Here's your {SEX_PRICE} coins. Take them — let's go.
Like I said. {SEX_PRICE} coins are yours. Don't stall.
Gold's yours. I'm already burning up.
Paid {SEX_PRICE} coins. About time.
Money's yours. Show me what I paid for.
Here are your coins. Now spread your legs.
{SEX_PRICE} gold — yours. On your knees.
Don't expect gentle — I like it hard.
Good bitch. Gold's yours — come here.
Wait… wait! I see how you're looking. Hands off — I won't touch you.
Shit… fine. We pushed it. Put the blade away — I'm backing off.
H-hey… easy. You're not joking — I feel it. Go on.
Fuck… I get it. Calm down.
Easy… That look in your eyes — I don't want to find out who wins.
Joke's over. Let's part ways quietly.
Alright, witch… you're right. I swear.
No hard feelings. Just… don't look at me like that.
Talk's done. I was kidding.
Got it. We're walking away.
Hey, watch who you threaten — I'll fuck you for that!
Don't talk so much — you'll tire your throat.
Seriously? This ends bad for you, witch.
Weak bravado. I'll fuck you till you break.
Words change nothing. I can take you by force.
Hands shaking, mouth bold. Put that tongue to work, bitch.
Alright, go. We're not holding you.
See you another night.
Take care of yourself.
Fine, move along.
Next time you know where to find me.
Good luck. Won't forget you.
Next time I won't be this nice.
Go on. Think about what I said.
